title: A.I. rapper FN Meka dropped by Capitol Records after 'gross stereotypes' backlash (Fortune)
notes: Fortune (top-tier), Alice Hearing, 2022-08-24. FN Meka = AI/AR virtual rapper; first AR artist signed to a major label (Capitol); debut single 'Florida Water' (2022-08-12, feat. Clix & Gunna); 500K+ Spotify monthly listeners + 10M+ TikTok followers at the time; dropped by Capitol + removed from streaming after racist-stereotype backlash.
